subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A delivery rider showed students how he used a map app to choose routes.”?
options: Families also used them for cooking and walking outside after dark.
The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.
The announcer gave information about closed roads, shelters, and when power might return.
The app slowly changed, but she also learned to step outside its suggestions.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Families also used them for cooking and walking outside after dark.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The announcer gave information about closed roads, shelters, and when power might return.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The app slowly changed, but she also learned to step outside its suggestions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.」，答案為「The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The app gave fast roads, but he also used his own knowledge.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
